texts: On day 68 of Year 1, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
The Council discussed the sky-cat drought.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the autumn feather store would be small.
The Council discussed a stricter feather ration for the winter.
Old Vesh reported to the Council that a thin feather autumn had also come before the bad winter of twenty-six years ago.
The Council recorded the observation in the ledger.

q2_gaps: day-of-year date ('day 68 of Year 1') — the Time term (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot (cf. 'June 5, 2021' -> (Day 5)); no day-of-year term is defined, so (Day 68) is indistinguishable from a day-of-month and no rule says how to record an ordinal day within a year

attributive / elided-standard comparative ('a stricter feather ration') — Comparatives & degree gives it no licensed form, so the qualifier is dropped and the recorded claim is about a plain feather ration
review.notes: 'Old Vesh' is symbolized vesh with the epithet kept only in the Name string — that follows the courtesy-title rule but not the mechanical 'a capitalized modifier joins the capitalized run' cue (cf. upper_calderwick); either reading is defensible and the Name string is faithful either way. Seal discipline in s4/s6 is right: definite typing and the compound genus project to top level while the sealed witness, 'thin' and 'bad' stay inside, and no predication of either report's content is asserted.
